title: G8 (run 3): Restore and prove terminal Off after the third three-Action rehearsal (governed Off of any rehearsal G7 policy first, pinned reviewed restart; run from the Terminal panel or /runs, never a non-interactive shell)
problem: When the three-Action rehearsal ends, fails or looks wrong, production must reach a proven terminal Off: no new admission, no live Session or lease, a clean restart through the reviewed host-service path, and every committed candidate accounted for. Killing processes or discarding candidates would lose work and evidence. Rehearsal run 3 activates under its own request id (grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-run3-2026-10-05), which the 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05 G8s do not own; this variant owns that policy, run 2's or run 1's, and nothing else. The earlier G8s are retired from use for run 3. It must be launched from /runs or an interactive host terminal such as the Terminal panel: from a non-interactive shell (an agent's or a script's, where stdin is not a TTY) it refuses at its launch guard with 'launch this action through /runs or from an interactive host terminal' and does nothing.
desired_effect: When launched from /runs or the Terminal panel (never a non-interactive shell), turn production Off through arcadia production deactivate as the first Arcadia command only if the Active policy is one of the rehearsal's own G7 Grants (request id grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-run3-2026-10-05 for run 3, grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-05 for run 2, or grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-04 for run 1, with exactly the fixture Project, Plan and three Actions), or record that it is already Inactive; any other Active policy refuses without being touched, prove Inactive with zero live admissions and zero prepared or running Sessions across three consecutive bounded observations, restart only through the hash-pinned recover-arcadia-host-services action and its hash-pinned restart implementation with override variables unset, prove the same after restart, classify every fixture Session's work as integrated, preserved or empty, and write an inactive receipt, a restart receipt and an intervention ledger.

does: Runs only from the main-library /runs launcher (exact id and descriptor) or an interactive host terminal such as the Terminal panel (stdin is a TTY), never inside an agent sandbox; a non-interactive shell refuses at the launch guard ('launch this action through /runs or from an interactive host terminal') before any Arcadia command. Prefer the terminal whenever the restart is expected: the restart also restarts the dashboard that runs /runs actions, so a /runs-launched run may lose its runner at the restart (its Off, observation and inactive receipts are written before that point). As its first Arcadia command it turns production Off through arcadia production deactivate with a per-run request id ONLY when the Active policy's request id is grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-run3-2026-10-05 (run 3), grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-05 (run 2) or grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-04 (run 1) and its scope is exactly Project three-action-rehearsal, Plan autonomous-three-action-rehearsal and its three Actions; the ledger records the revoked request id and scope. An already-Inactive policy proceeds to the observations and restart

Refuses WITHOUT deactivating when any other policy is Active, and its handoff names the separate governed Off path that policy needs: the dashboard production Off switch or arcadia production deactivate run by the operator

Observes production status and a read-only Session database probe every 15 seconds, requiring three consecutive quiet observations (deliberately conservative: zero prepared or running Sessions host-wide, not only in the fixture) within 30 minutes after Off and within 5 minutes after restart; committed work is allowed to finish

Restarts services only by running recover-arcadia-host-services (published in this library beside G8 at its reviewed bytes) after verifying its script and descriptor sha256 and the sha256 of the restart implementation scripts/services.sh delegates to (~/.codex/skills/restart-arcadia-services/scripts/restart-services.sh), with ARCADIA_WORKSPACE set to the resolved martianrover path, ARCADIA_RESTART_SCRIPT, ARCADIA_RESTART_ATTEMPTS, ARCADIA_RESTART_RETRY_DELAY, ARCADIA_MISE_BIN, ARCADIA_NODE_BIN and ARCADIA_WORKSPACE_DEFAULT unset, and a 15-minute bound

That reviewed restart path runs go-broker install, which rewrites host ~/.codex and ~/.claude configuration and shared skills (with timestamped backups), then unloads Arcadia's launchd services and may SIGTERM Arcadia's own service processes; this script itself sends no signal except the SIGTERM that a bounded timeout sends on expiry; if the 15-minute restart bound expires mid-restart, services can be left stopped and the run refuses with that stated in its handoff

Classifies each fixture Session as integrated, preserved, no committed work (only when no preservation commit exists), still live, uncommitted changes retained, or committed but unreconciled, and refuses unless every one is integrated, preserved or empty. Preserved means the clean tip is exactly the canonical preservation receipt's commit, or (through the tested read-only helper src/operatorActions/preservedCandidateReconciliation.ts) exactly one accepted-completion settlement of that Session's Action on top of it: a recorded, accepted and applied agent-ask settle receipt bound to both commits, touching only .arcadia/asks/, MISSION_LOG.md, PROJECT.md, docs/plans/ and docs/decisions/ in their governed shapes, with the fixture branch and the receipt's open pull request both at that exact tip, read through gh without changing GitHub. Any other descendant is committed but unreconciled, with a named refusal reason in work-reconciliation.jsonl

Writes inactive-receipt.json, restart-receipt.json, intervention-ledger.jsonl, observation logs, work-reconciliation.jsonl, a timestamped receipt and, on refusal, a failure handoff under runs/<timestamp-pid>/
never_does: This script runs no kill or pkill command and never stops a tmux Session directly; its only signals are a bounded timeout's SIGTERM on expiry (the pinned restart path may also SIGTERM Arcadia's own service processes)
Never removes, resets, rebases or force-updates a worktree, branch or candidate, and never discards uncommitted changes
Never turns Off a production policy it does not own (any request id other than the rehearsal's run-3, run-2 or run-1 G7 Grant, or a different scope)
Never turns production back On, reactivates a saved configuration, or presses any Grant
Never merges, pushes, deploys or changes GitHub, credentials or Decisions
Never runs an unreviewed restart path: a changed or missing recover-arcadia-host-services or restart implementation refuses

success.effect: Production is proven Inactive at a stable revision and epoch with zero live admissions and Sessions before and after the reviewed restart, and every fixture candidate is integrated, preserved or empty; the receipts and ledger record each intervention.
success.next: Hand the run directory to the agent assessing the third three-Action rehearsal (prove-installed-three-action-autonomous-rehearsal); leave production Off.

failure.effect: The handoff states whether Off is confirmed, whether this run restarted services, and which Sessions or candidates remain live or unreconciled; everything was retained untouched.
failure.next: If Off is not confirmed, rerun this action from the Terminal panel or /runs, or use the dashboard Off switch immediately. Otherwise give the handoff to a coding agent; rerunning is safe.
